# Relay stage 2: Research
Task: 10-reset-flagged-task-button
Working directory: /Volumes/Tera/dev/visual-relay/
Protected paths (queue bookkeeping — never part of this task's diff): llm-tasks/, .relay/, .relay-scratch/, .swival/

## Task input
## Task: Add a Reset button that returns a flagged task to pending without starting it

A flagged ("Needs review") task currently has two exits: Resume (continue the
flagged run where it stopped) or Mark done (archive it). There is no way to
say "discard that run; queue this task fresh, later." Add a **Reset** button:
it returns the flagged task to its initial pending state but never starts it —
the task simply becomes eligible for a future Run All. Reviewing and
queue-tending happen while long drains run, so Reset must work on a flagged
task even while another task is executing.

### Evidence (verified)

- A task is "Needs review" because `.relay/<taskId>/NEEDS-REVIEW` exists;
  `RelayTaskRepository.ListAsync` maps the marker to `NeedsReview`, drain
  collection excludes such tasks (`CollectNewTasks` in
  `RelayQueueController.PrivateHelpers.cs`:
  `!t.NeedsReview && !seenIds.Contains(t.Id)`), and `FailedRunContext`
  surfaces the flag reason in the detail panel.
- Removing the marker alone is NOT a reset: GUI runs always use
  `RelayDriverOptions(Resume: true)` (`GuiTaskRunner.cs`), so leftover
  `.relay/<taskId>/` stage state (status.json, stageN-attemptM artifacts,
  run-base.txt, …) would make the next run RESUME the flagged pipeline
  mid-flight instead of starting from stage 1.
- The flagged run's `flagged-work.bundle` can hold the ONLY copy of the run's
  authored work: when `hoist-pipeline-test-shared-setup` flagged on
  2026-07-16, the post-flag worktree reset deleted its three authored test
  files from the tree — the bundle is their sole record. A reset that deletes
  the run directory outright destroys evidence and possibly work.
- The flagged-state buttons live in
  `src/VisualRelay.App/Views/Controls/TaskActionBar.axaml` (Resume, Mark
  done). Mark done is the destructive-command template: GUI confirm modal,
  listed in `DefaultConfirmGatedCommands` (`ControlApi.cs`) so the API
  requires `{"confirm":true}` and awaits completion so `{ok:true}` means the
  effect took.
- The control API mirrors every UI command by name (`ResolveCommand` switch +
  `IcommandNames`); `/state`'s per-command enabled map and the index page
  derive from those arrays automatically.
- `DrainAsync` seeds `seenIds` from the starting queue
  (`RelayQueueController.cs`), so a task whose `NeedsReview` flips false
  mid-drain is collected at the next Sequential/RestartBetweenTasks boundary
  exactly like a newly added task. Standard mode collects nothing mid-drain.

### What to build

1. **Core reset action**: for a flagged task, archive the entire run-state
   directory in one filesystem move — e.g. rename `.relay/<taskId>/` to
   `.relay/<taskId>.reset-<utc-stamp>/` (rename-don't-delete, the
   `RestartHandoff.MarkConsumed` precedent) — so the NEEDS-REVIEW marker,
   stage state, logs, and flagged-work bundle leave the live path together
   but remain on disk for post-mortem. Afterwards the task lists as Pending
   with no run history, and its next run starts at stage 1 (no Resume
   pickup).
2. **UI**: a Reset button in `TaskActionBar.axaml` beside Resume/Mark done,
   enabled exactly when the selected task is flagged — including while
   another task is running (`IsBusy` must not gate it). Confirm modal before
   acting. It must never start a run.
3. **Control API**: a confirm-gated command (e.g. `reset-selected`) following
   the mark-done pattern end to end: `ResolveCommand`,
   `DefaultConfirmGatedCommands`, `IcommandNames`, awaited to completion;
   button and API share one CanExecute.
4. **Semantics under an active drain (deliberate, pin in tests)**: Reset only
   returns the task to Pending. Under an in-flight Sequential or
   RestartBetweenTasks drain it becomes eligible at the next boundary via the
   existing new-task collection; under Standard, nothing picks it up until
   the next Run All. State this in the button's tooltip so the behavior is
   discoverable.
5. **Hygiene**: `.relay/<id>.reset-*` archives are invisible to the task
   repository, stage-state loading (including the load-time reconciliation
   from task 06), and drain scans.

### Constraints

- This task runs after 02/06/07: build on the landed NEEDS-REVIEW ownership
  (07) and stale-state reconciliation (06) — do not add another marker
  writer or a parallel notion of "flagged".
- Never delete flagged-work bundles or killed-output autopsies — archive
  only.
- Concurrency: resetting task A while task B runs must not touch task B's
  state or the drain's control flow; a repository scan racing the rename
  must see either the pre- or post-reset view, never throw.
- Repo-agnostic; keep files under the 300-line guard; TimeProvider patterns
  for any test waits.

### Tests (red first)

- Core: flagged task with populated run state → reset → lists Pending, no
  NEEDS-REVIEW, archive dir exists with the bundle intact, and a subsequent
  run request starts at stage 1 rather than resuming.
- Gating: CanExecute true for a flagged selected task while another task is
  running; false when the selected task isn't flagged; GUI confirm and API
  `{"confirm":true}` both required (409 without, no effect).
- Drain interaction: reset during an active sequential drain leaves the
  running task undisturbed and the reset task joins at the next boundary;
  the reset itself never launches a run.
- Hygiene: repository listing ignores `.reset-*` directories.

### Verification

- `./visual-relay check` fully green including the new tests.
- Manual: flag a scratch task, reset it while another task runs, confirm it
  shows Pending with an archived run dir, then confirm a later Run All picks
  it up and starts from stage 1.

Here are my findings and constraints based on a thorough investigation of the codebase.

## Findings

### Core layer – `RelayTaskRepository` (`src/VisualRelay.Core/Tasks/`)
- **`RelayTaskRepository.cs`** — `ListAsync()` scans `llm-tasks/` (NOT `.relay/`). `AttachReviewState()` checks `.relay/<taskId>/NEEDS-REVIEW`. `AttachRunMetrics()` reads report files from `.relay/<taskId>/`. `IsSkippedName()` filters `DONE-*` and `IGNORE-*` prefixes. The `Walk` function never enters `.relay/`, so `.reset-*` archives there are invisible to task discovery.
- **`RelayTaskRepository.MarkDone.cs`** — Template for Reset: `MarkDoneAsync` calls `TaskCompletionArchive.RetireAsync` which moves files. Reset would be similar but rename the entire `.relay/<taskId>/` directory instead of the task spec.
- **`TaskCompletionArchive.cs`** — Handles the mark-done file moves with rollback. Reset uses a simpler rename-don't-delete approach (no rollback needed).
- **`FailedRunContext.cs`** — Reads `.relay/<taskId>/NEEDS-REVIEW`, `status.json`, verify-outputs, `ledger.md`. After rename, these paths are gone — the detail panel will show no flag reason (correct).

### Core layer – `RelayQueueController` (`src/VisualRelay.Core/Queue/`)
- **`RelayQueueController.cs`** — `DrainAsync` seeds `seenIds = new HashSet<string>(queue.Select(t => t.Id))` at line 120 (local variable). Key observation: `seenIds` is scoped to `DrainAsync` — to support mid-drain reset, either make it a field or add an alternative mechanism. `CollectNewTasks` checks `!t.NeedsReview && !seenIds.Contains(t.Id)`.
- **`RelayQueueController.PrivateHelpers.cs`** — `CollectNewTasks` at line 116. `SyncExternalTasks` at line 93 bridges GUI tasks into the controller.
- **`RestartHandoff.cs`** — `MarkConsumed` at line 87 is the rename-don't-delete precedent: `File.Move(path, path + ".consumed", overwrite: true)`. Reset follows same pattern.
- **`RelayRunHistory.cs`** — `ReadTaskMetric` and `ReadStatusRecord` access `.relay/<taskId>/`. After directory rename, they return empty metrics — task shows "No run history" (correct).

### View layer – `TaskActionBar` (`src/VisualRelay.App/Views/Controls/`)
- **`TaskActionBar.axaml`** — Has `Resume` (bound to `ResumeSelectedCommand`), `Mark done` (bound to `MarkSelectedTaskDoneCommand`, `IsVisible="{Binding IsMarkDoneButtonVisible}"`). Reset button goes beside Resume/Mark done.
- **`TaskActionBar.axaml.cs`** — Thin code-behind, just `InitializeComponent()`.

### ViewModel layer (`src/VisualRelay.App/ViewModels/`)
- **`MainWindowViewModel.MarkDone.cs`** — Pattern to replicate:
  - `[RelayCommand(CanExecute = nameof(CanMarkSelectedTaskDone))]` on `MarkSelectedTaskDoneAsync()`
  - `CanMarkSelectedTaskDone()` gates on `SelectedTask is not null && !SelectedTask.IsArchived && !ShowArchive && !IsBusy && !_runningTaskIds.Contains(SelectedTask.Id)`
  - `IsMarkDoneButtonVisible` controls button visibility
  - `OnShowArchiveChanged` / `OnIsBusyChanged` notify command changes
  - Reset must NOT gate on `IsBusy` (concurrent with running task). Must gate on `SelectedTask.NeedsReview`.
- **`MainWindowViewModel.Execution.cs`** — `RunOneAsync` at line 12 creates `RelayDriverOptions(Resume: resume)`. `GuiTaskRunner` always passes `Resume: true`.
- **`MainWindowViewModel.cs`** — Properties at lines 75–197: `_selectedTask`, `_isBusy`, `_showArchive`, `_runningTaskIds`. `NotifyCanExecuteChangedFor` attributes on `_selectedTask` line 97 reference `ResumeSelectedCommand` — Reset must be added similarly.
- **`MainWindowViewModel.Helpers.cs`** — `CanRunSelected()` at line 233: `!IsBusy && !PauseRequested && SelectedTask is not null && !SelectedTask.IsArchived`.
- **`MainWindowViewModel.LiveState.cs`** — `BeginRunningTask` at line 121 and `ClearRunningTask` at line 189 both notify `MarkSelectedTaskDoneCommand.NotifyCanExecuteChanged()` — Reset needs the same treatment.

### Control API (`src/VisualRelay.App/Services/`)
- **`ControlApi.cs`** — `ResolveCommand` switch at line 32 maps names to `ICommand`s. `DefaultConfirmGatedCommands` at line 64 = `["mark-done", "rewrite-selected"]`. Reset command name e.g. `"reset-selected"` goes in both.
- **`ControlApi.State.cs`** — `IcommandNames` at line 119 = string array of all command names. Reset name goes here. `BuildCommandsMap()` iterates `IcommandNames` and calls `CanExecute(null)` for each.

### Domain (`src/VisualRelay.Domain/`)
- **`RelayTaskItem.cs`** — `NeedsReview` computed from `!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(ReviewReason)`. `StateLabel` returns `"Needs review"` when flagged. After reset, `ReviewReason` is null → `Pending`.

### Tests (`tests/VisualRelay.Tests/`)
- **`TestDoubles.cs`** — `TestRepository` has `WriteNeedsReview()`, `WriteConfig()`, `WriteNestedTask()`, etc. Uses temp dirs cleaned up on dispose.
- **`MainWindowViewModelMarkDoneTests.cs`** — Pattern: create repo, load VM, select task, assert `CanExecute`, execute command, assert effect.
- **`ControlApiConfirmGatedTests.cs`** — Pattern: create repo + VM + window + API, assert confirm-gated behavior.
- **`TaskActionBarLayoutTests.cs`** — Pattern: create window, find `TaskActionBar` visual descendant, locate button by name, assert visibility/command.
- **`RelayTaskRepositoryTests.cs`** — Pattern: create repo, write tasks/config, call repository methods, assert results.

---

## Constraints

1. **Must not delete data** — Archive via rename only (`.relay/<taskId>/` → `.relay/<taskId>.reset-<utc-stamp>/`). Never delete `flagged-work.bundle`, report files, logs, or any run artifacts. `RestartHandoff.MarkConsumed` rename precedent.
2. **Concurrency** — Reset must work while another task is running. Must not gate on `IsBusy`. Must not touch another task's state. The directory rename (`Directory.Move`) in `.relay/` is atomic per filesystem semantics — a racing repository scan sees either old name or new name, never partial.
3. **Resume prevention** — `GuiTaskRunner` always passes `Resume: true`. By moving the entire `.relay/<taskId>/` directory, leftover `status.json`, `run-base.txt`, etc. are removed from the live path, so the next run starts at stage 1.
4. **NEEDS-REVIEW marker removal** — The marker lives in `.relay/<taskId>/NEEDS-REVIEW`. The directory rename naturally removes it from the scan path — no separate marker deletion needed.
5. **seenIds eviction for active drain** — `CollectNewTasks` in `RelayQueueController.PrivateHelpers.cs` checks `!seenIds.Contains(t.Id)`. The `seenIds` HashSet is local to `DrainAsync`. A `RemoveFromSeen(string taskId)` method must be added (storing seenIds as a field) so a reset during an active Sequential/RestartBetweenTasks drain makes the task eligible at the next boundary.
6. **Archive invisibility to repository** — The `.relay/<id>.reset-*` directories must not appear in any listing. This is naturally satisfied because `Walk()` only scans `llm-tasks/`, not `.relay/`. However, `AttachReviewState` checks `.relay/<taskId>/NEEDS-REVIEW` — after rename this path doesn't exist, so the task correctly appears as Pending. `ReadTaskMetric`/`ReadStatusRecord` access `.relay/<taskId>/` and return empty after rename.
7. **Confirm modal** — Reset must show a confirm dialog (same as Mark done) via `ConfirmAsync` seam. The Control API requires `{"confirm":true}` and lists in `DefaultConfirmGatedCommands`.
8. **CanExecute gating** — Reset button enabled when `SelectedTask is not null && SelectedTask.NeedsReview && !ShowArchive`. **Must NOT** gate on `IsBusy` or `_runningTaskIds` (contrast with `CanMarkSelectedTaskDone`). Must gate on the selected task being flagged.
9. **Button visibility** — Reset button visible when `SelectedTask is not null && SelectedTask.NeedsReview && !ShowArchive`.
10. **`NotifyCanExecuteChangedFor`** — The Reset command must be added to the `[NotifyCanExecuteChangedFor(...)]` attributes on `_selectedTask`, `_showArchive`, and any property whose change should refresh the command's CanExecute.
11. **`IcommandNames` + `DefaultConfirmGatedCommands` + `ResolveCommand`** — The new command name (e.g. `"reset-selected"`) must be registered in all three arrays in `ControlApi.cs` and `ControlApi.State.cs`.
12. **Tooltip for discoverability** — Button tooltip must state the mid-drain behavior: "Returns the task to pending — eligible at the next drain boundary under Sequential/RestartBetweenTasks, or the next Run All under Standard mode."
13. **300-line file guard** — Each file must stay under 300 lines. New methods should be added in new partial-class files (e.g. `RelayTaskRepository.ResetTask.cs`, `MainWindowViewModel.ResetTask.cs`).
14. **TimeProvider** — Any test waits must use `TimeProvider` patterns (see `ManualTimeProvider.cs` in tests).
15. **Existing NEEDS-REVIEW ownership** — Do not add another marker writer or parallel notion of "flagged." Build on the existing NEEDS-REVIEW mechanism (task 07) and stale-state reconciliation (task 06).
16. **UI command name** — The command name `"reset-selected"` flows through `ResolveCommand`, `IcommandNames`, `DefaultConfirmGatedCommands`, and the `/state` commands map automatically.
